Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. blocker (line 1465): In describe("lasso selection mode"), setup() renders <Excalidraw /> without setting non-zero viewport dimensions (h.state.width and h.state.height), so after restoreOriginalGetBoundingClientRect() runs in an earlier suite (line 1142), h.state.width and h.state.height default to 0 in jsdom and Renderer.getVisibleCanvasElements (isElementInViewport) culls every element whose bounds do not contain (0, 0) from h.app.visibleElements (specifically rect2 at x: 100 and child at x: 50, y: 20), causing LassoTrail.updateSelection() to never see those elements in the 3 failing pointer-driven tests. — fix: Set h.state.width = 1000 and h.state.height = 1000 inside the act(() => { ... }) block in setup() (matching packages/excalidraw/tests/lasso.test.tsx lines 47-48) so all scene elements in the suite lie within the viewport and are included in h.app.visibleElements before API.setElements() and pointer lasso strokes run.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/selection.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
